narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. Nothing else needed changing.
